subtitle: 老師該不該在週末出作業？表達你的看法
task: Some people think teachers should not give students homework on weekends. Do you agree or disagree? Give reasons and examples to support your opinion.
taskZh: 有人認為老師不應該在週末出作業給學生。你同意還是不同意？請提出理由和例子支持你的看法。
focus: 每個理由都有說明或例子
用 First／Second／In conclusion 組織文章

en: I agree that teachers should not give students homework on weekends. I have two reasons.
First, students need time to rest. We study at school for eight hours a day from Monday to Friday, so we are often tired by the weekend. If we can relax, we will learn better the next week.
Second, weekends are a good time to do other things. For example, I like to play basketball and visit my grandparents on Sundays. These activities are also important for us.
In conclusion, I believe weekends should be homework-free. Students will be happier and healthier.
zh: 我同意老師不應該在週末出作業給學生。我有兩個理由。
第一，學生需要時間休息。我們週一到週五每天在學校讀書八小時，所以到了週末常常很累。如果能好好放鬆，下週會學得更好。
第二，週末很適合做其他事。例如，我喜歡在星期天打籃球、去看爺爺奶奶。這些活動對我們來說也很重要。
總之，我認為週末應該沒有作業。學生會更快樂、更健康。
